scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run native && electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run native && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.build:arm64: npm run build:web && npm run native && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mas: npm run build:web && npm run native && electron-builder --mac mas --universal --publish never -c.mas.provisioningProfile="$CLEARMIND_MAS_PROFILE" -c.buildVersion="${CLEARMIND_BUILD_NUMBER:-1}"
scripts.build:mas-dev: npm run build:web && npm run native && electron-builder --mac mas-dev --arm64 --publish never -c.masDev.provisioningProfile="$CLEARMIND_MAS_DEV_PROFILE"
